summary: BLUT and Katana process adapters are merged into OpenWarrant; Katana native receipt interfaces merged upstream at 5a735133 with all hosted checks passing. A candidate core collector enrollment codec checks exact current authority, human-admin signature policy, executable/provider identity and explicit Warrant scope. Seven synthetic-adapter controls and 704 core regressions pass. Real cryptographic transport, protected operator custody, activation, native collector wiring and independent/participant qualification remain open.
next_steps: Implement reference signature verification and protected collector enrollment/activation; pure SDK checks do not authenticate or isolate the host.
Wire trusted collector policy and native verifier into the actual workflow request/response path; preserve UNKNOWN for absent custody, spend or confinement observations.
Complete actual provider integrations, independent verification and participant qualification without inventing acceptance.
